integrity: Exact proof uses cited coherent-system extension sequence and ordinary line-bundle cohomology; included finite exact-arithmetic checker is corroborative, not a proof for all m. No independent review claimed.
scientific_limitations: Classification only of nonsimple rank-three exponent-five m-unisolvent systems on fixed P1. Projective sets classify isomorphism classes, not moduli schemes or \(\operatorname{PGL}_2\)-quotients. Bundle jump computed for \(m=4\) only; historical priority provisional.
title: Rank-three unisolvent extension classes and the first determinantal splitting wall
